schema:name: Public health authority
schema:description: National or subnational public health authority (such as a ministry of health) responsible for governance, health and digital health policies, change management, local adoption, cybersecurity, privacy, confidentiality, data use policies, and leading scale-up and phase-out of paper or legacy systems. (Section 2.2, Ch. 3, 5 & 6 panels, PDF 24, 30, 64, 68)
